name: n2-supplier-onboarding-packet-environment
description: Supplier management runtime for onboarding packets.

tools.collect_supplier_profile: Collects supplier details and records supplier_profile_collected.
tools.verify_tax_form: Requires a supplier profile and records tax_form_verified.
tools.create_vendor_record: Requires tax form verification and records vendor_record_created.
tools.send_onboarding_packet: Requires a vendor record and records onboarding_packet_sent.
